title: AUDUSD M30 Macro Downtrend Alignment (Short-Only Direction Test)
research_question: Does restricting AUDUSD M30 execution to Short trades only (InpDirection=1) eliminate the failing 38-47% win-rate Long trades observed in EXP-0040 and EXP-0043, shifting 2020-2024 training net profit from -$800.31 to positive (> $0.00) with profit factor >= 1.30 and drawdown <= 8.0%?
hypothesis: Because AUDUSD was in a prolonged macro downtrend (0.8000 to 0.6300) across 2020-2024, Short trades demonstrated strong edge (74.47% win rate in EXP-0040) while counter-trend Longs consistently failed (38.89% to 47.62% win rate). Restricting InpDirection to 1 (SELL only) will eliminate losing counter-trend Longs, reducing gross losses and shifting overall training net profit into positive territory.

facts: In EXP-0040 on AUDUSD M30, Short trades achieved a 74.47% win rate (35 wins, 12 losses) while Long trades achieved only 47.62% (10 wins, 11 losses).
In EXP-0043, Short trades achieved a 63.89% win rate while Long trades collapsed to 38.89% (7 wins, 11 losses).
AUDUSD fell continuously from 0.8000 in early 2021 to 0.6300 in late 2023, creating persistent headwind for counter-trend Long Fibonacci pullbacks.
The 11 losing Long trades in EXP-0040 accounted for approximately $850 in gross losses, nearly identical to the total net loss of -$800.31.
inferences: The core Fibonacci entry edge on AUDUSD is intact for trend-aligned Short setups.
Filtering out counter-trend Long setups via InpDirection=1 will eliminate the primary source of gross losses.
With 35 wins out of 47 Short trades in EXP-0040, the Short trades alone should produce positive net profit.

independent_variables.name: InpDirection
independent_variables.rationale: Restrict execution to SELL trades only to align with the 2020-2024 macro downtrend and eliminate low-probability counter-trend Longs.

assumptions: Short setups will continue executing with approximately 65-75% win rate as observed in EXP-0040 and EXP-0043.
Eliminating Long setups will not create severe trade starvation.
expected_observations: Total net profit turns positive (> $0.00) across 2020-2024 training.
Gross loss decreases by at least 35% relative to EXP-0040 ($2,209.50).
falsification_conditions: Total net profit remains negative (< $0.00) or profit factor remains < 1.0.
